items.rationale: Clauses 2.3.3, 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) distinguish the required police report from the cost of translating it. All 68 lines are excluded.
The translation provider's working materials are excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f), even when billed separately.

items.description: Robbery compensation for watch and cash
items.rationale: The reported armed robbery away from home is covered under 2.3 and 11.1, subject to the itemisation required by 7.1.10. Allow €2,500 for the unscheduled watch and €500 for cash under 4.2.2–4.2.3; the €5,000 away-from-home limit does not reduce that total, and the single €50 deductible leaves €2,950.
Forwarding charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b) and 11.4 even when billed alongside covered property compensation.
